name: Galaxy Note 10

Launch.Predecessor: Samsung Galaxy Note 9, Samsung Galaxy Note 3 Neo (direct for Note 10 Lite), Samsung Galaxy Note FE (indirect for Note 10 Lite)
Launch.Successor: Samsung Galaxy Note 20, Samsung Galaxy S20 FE (for Note 10 Lite)

Network.SIM: nanoSIM, eSIM, Single SIM or Hybrid Dual SIM in dual stand-by

Body.Weight: Note 10: 5.9 oz, Note 10+: 6.98 oz, Note 10 Lite: 7.02 oz

Platform.Operating system: Original (Note 10 and Note 10+): Android 9 "Pie" with One UI 1.5, Original (Note 10 Lite): Android 10 with One UI 2.0, Current (Note 10 and Note 10+): Android 12 with One UI 4.1, Current (Note 10 Lite): Android 13 with One UI 5.1
Platform.Chipset: Worldwide: Samsung Exynos 9 Series 9825, U.S., Canada, Hong Kong, China, Japan and Latin America (Except Brazil): Qualcomm Snapdragon 855, Note 10 Lite: Samsung Exynos 9 Series 9810
Platform.CPU: Octa-core, Exynos 9825:, 2*2.73 GHz Mongoose M4, 2*2.4 GHz ARM Cortex-A75, Cortex-A75, 4*1.9 GHz Cortex-A55, Snapdragon:, 1*2.8 GHz Kryo 485, 3*2.4 GHz Kryo 485, 4*1.7 GHz Kryo 485, Exynos 9810:, 4*2.7 GHz Mongoose M3, 4*1.7 GHz Cortex-A55
Platform.GPU: Exynos 9825: Mali-G76 MP12, Snapdragon: Adreno 640, Exynos 9810: Mali-G72 MP18

Memory.RAM: Note 10: 8 GB/12 GB RAM, Note 10+: 12 GB RAM, Note 10 Lite: 6 GB/8 GB RAM
Memory.Storage: Note 10: 256 GB UFS 3.0, Note 10+: 256 GB/512 GB UFS 3.0, Note 10 Lite: 128 GB UFS 2.1
Memory.Card slot: Note 10: none, Note 10+: microSD card support up to 1 TB, Note 10 Lite: microSD card support up to 1 TB

Display.Display: Note 10: 2280×1080 1080p Dynamic AMOLED Gorilla Glass 6 6.3 in (160.0 mm), (401 ppi), Note 10+: 3040×1440 1440p Dynamic AMOLED Gorilla Glass 6 6.8 in (172.7 mm), (498 ppi), Note 10 Lite: 2400×1080 1080p Super AMOLED Gorilla Glass 3 1080p 6.7 in (170.2 mm), (394 ppi), All: capacitive touchscreen HDR10+ Infinity-O display

Cameras.Rear camera: Note 10 and Note 10+:, Primary: 12 Megapixel, MP, f-number, f/1.5-2.4, 27mm, 1/2.55", 1.4Micrometre, µm, dual pixel Phase detection autofocus, PDAF, Image stabilization#Optical image stabilization, OIS, Telephoto: 12 Megapixel, MP, f-number, f/2.1, 52mm, 1/3.6", 1.0Micrometre, µm, Phase detection autofocus, PDAF, Image stabilization#Optical image stabilization, OIS, 2x optical zoom, Ultrawide: 16 Megapixel, MP, f-number, f/2.2, 12mm, 1/3.1", 1.0Micrometre, µm, Super Steady video, VGA DepthVision (Note 10+), Note 10 Lite:, Primary: 12 Megapixel, MP, f-number, f/1.7, 27mm, 1/2.55", 1.4Micrometre, µm, dual pixel Phase detection autofocus, PDAF, Image stabilization#Optical image stabilization, O
Cameras.Front camera: Note 10 & Note 10+: 10 MP, f/2.2, 26mm (wide), 1/3", 1.22µm, dual pixel PDAF, Note 10 Lite: 32 MP, f/2.2, 25mm (wide), 1/2.8", 0.8µm

Sound.Sound: Dolby Atmos stereo speaker tuned by AKG

Battery.Battery: Note 10: 3500 mAh, Note 10+: 4300 mAh, Note 10 Lite: 4500 mAh
Battery.Charging: Note 10 and Note 10 Lite: Fast charging up to 25W , Note 10+: Fast charging up to 45W , Qi & reverse wireless charging (excluding Note 10 Lite)
